# AI Football Predictor

> AI Football Predictor gives the win, draw and loss probability of every football match in 29 competitions (Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Champions League, national cups and more), and checks every probability publicly against the real result. It offers a free football widget that any website or blog can embed in two lines of code, with no signup and no API key.

Key facts:
- Free football widget for websites and blogs (WordPress, Wix, Blogger, Webflow, Squarespace, Shopify). No signup, no API key, no cost.
- Shows the next matches with win / draw / loss probabilities. Matches where a team has at least a 65% chance to win are highlighted.
- Filters: one or several competitions, or a single club. Dark or light theme. 1 to 20 matches. French or English.
- Updated automatically. Lazy loaded in an iframe, so it does not slow the host page down.
- Every probability is locked before kickoff and compared with the real result on a public reliability page.
- Probabilities, not certainty. Not betting advice. 18+.
- Made by @jeremstyke (https://t.me/jeremstyke).

## Free football widget

- [Free football widget (English)](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/): configurator, live preview, code to copy, install guide, FAQ.
- [Widget foot gratuit (français)](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/fr/widget/): même page en français.
- [Free live football widget (English)](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/widget/live/): live score, minute, scorers, match stats and win probabilities that move during the match. Add data-type="live" to the embed code.
- [Widget foot en direct gratuit (français)](https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/fr/widget/live/): score en direct, buteurs, stats et probabilités qui évoluent pendant le match.

Embed code (paste where the widget should appear):

```html
<div class="afp-widget" data-lang="en" data-lg="E0,CL" data-n="6"><a href="https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/">Football probabilities by AI Football Predictor</a></div>
<script async src="https://jeremstyke.github.io/ai-football-predictor/embed.js"></script>
```

Options: data-type (empty = upcoming matches with probabilities, live = live matches), data-lang (en or fr), data-lg (competition codes, comma separated, empty = all), data-team (exact club name), data-n (1 to 20), data-theme (dark or light).

Competition codes: E0 Premier League, F1 Ligue 1, SP1 LaLiga, I1 Serie A, D1 Bundesliga, CL Champions League, P1 Liga Portugal, N1 Eredivisie, SC0 Scottish Premiership, B1 Belgian Pro League, T1 Süper Lig, G1 Super League Greece, ROU Romania Liga 1, NOR Eliteserien, BRA Brasileirão, ARG Liga Profesional Argentina, HR HNL Croatia, RS Serbian SuperLiga, UA Ukrainian Premier League, SA Saudi Pro League, CY Cyprus First Division, BG Bulgarian First League, FAC FA Cup, EFL EFL Cup, DFB DFB-Pokal, CDR Copa del Rey, SCC Scottish Cup, SLC Scottish League Cup, TDP Taça de Portugal.

Install: WordPress "Custom HTML" block; Wix Add > Embed > HTML code; Blogger "HTML/JavaScript" gadget; Webflow, Squarespace, Shopify "Embed" or "Code" block.
